annotations.title: Count the people following a transfer

description: Count how many people follow a transfer's updates by email: those who receive its email alerts through its share link or payment record link, from sign-ups they confirmed and have not stopped, each address once. An archived transfer sends no alerts, so it counts none. It never returns their addresses, and alert sign-ups are made and stopped only by each person. Reading changes nothing.
name: get_watcher_count
